description: Ring up sales on 11 registers; card payments on P2PE PIN pads; loyalty lookups
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 85% of store sales are by card; about $4,000 in sales per open hour; customers leave full carts; POS journal copied to the vendor cloud hourly
manual_workaround: Cash-only lanes with a posted notice; hand-written receipts for large orders; no manual card entry (would break P2PE scope)
dependent_third_parties: POS vendor; payment processor; internet provider

description: Customers browse, order, and pay through the processor's embedded form; pickup and delivery slots
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 12% of sales (about 95 orders a day); customers can shop in store; storefront vendor states a 4-hour recovery time and near-zero data loss
manual_workaround: Phone orders for pickup with payment at the store on a PIN pad; social media notice

description: Pick orders with handhelds; hand over at curbside; deliver in 4 zones
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Orders already paid; cold-chain limits for delivered perishables; customer promises by time slot
manual_workaround: Print pick lists from the storefront; call customers to reschedule

description: Case temperature sensors, controllers, alarms, and temperature logs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $150,000 of refrigerated and frozen stock; unsafe food must not reach customers; temperature logs support food safety records
manual_workaround: Manual thermometer checks every 2 hours with a paper log; move product to the walk-in cooler; discard when time and temperature limits are passed
dependent_third_parties: Refrigeration and building controls contractor; utility

description: Receive deliveries; maintain items and prices; send the nightly price file to the POS and storefront
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Prices from the previous file stay valid; deliveries can be received on paper
manual_workaround: Paper receiving log; keep yesterday's price file; key urgent price changes at the POS back office
dependent_third_parties: Back office and inventory vendor; suppliers

description: Member lookup at checkout; points; personalized offers and dynamic online prices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Checkout works without loyalty; missed points can be credited later; a breach of member data has contractual and reputational impact
manual_workaround: Honor posted member prices at the register; credit points after recovery; pause the pricing engine and use shelf prices online

description: Time capture; biweekly payroll; onboarding and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; late pay has legal and retention impact
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider

business_process: Accounting, supplier payments, and card settlement reconciliation
description: Pay suppliers; reconcile card deposits and chargebacks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Supplier terms allow a few days; chargeback response deadlines
manual_workaround: Pay urgent suppliers from the bank portal; reconcile later from processor reports
